name: compile_markdown_to_pdf
description: Compiles a Markdown file to a PDF file using pandoc and the typst engine, configuring a fallback font to avoid empty fallback font list issues in WSL/Nix.

input_path.description: Absolute path to the input Markdown (.md) file.

output_path.description: Absolute path to the output PDF (.pdf) file.

font.description: The mainfont variable to override. Defaults to 'Liberation Sans'.

working_dir.description: The directory from which relative image paths inside the Markdown are resolved. Defaults to the directory containing the input file.
